ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; the visible surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels with sparse, high-intensity (white) linear and punctate markers.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-intensity field across both lobes; secondary mapping identifies thin, high-contrast white linear segments (scratches) scattered medially and several high-intensity clusters localized at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression; vertex angle approximately 45 degrees with significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities across the entire trailing edge; distinct high-amplitude jagged peaks (nicks) located on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curvature following a parabolic path from the peduncle to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse, circular high-contrast pixel clusters (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) concentrated at the lateral extreme tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear disruptions; three prominent parallel vertical streaks on the upper medial region of the left lobe and diagonal intersecting marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of extensive multi-directional linear abrasions (rake marks) and small irregular nicks/material loss along the trailing edge perimeter.
